summary: Waterlogging and broken drainage in Pilkhuwa, an unfinished underpass, and repair of roads dominate complaints, while the few positives are planned works rather than completed ones.

positives.english: Roads and drains are to be built in Pilkhuwa wards two to six
positives.hindi: *पिलखुवा के वार्ड दो से छह में सड़कें और नालियां बनने वाली हैं
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (24 Aug 2026) reports Rs 2.25 crore for about 2.5 km of roads and drains in wards 2-6 of Pilkhuwa, tenders issued, work said to start end-September; start not confirmed in any later source. Pilkhuwa MB is inside AC per Wikipedia extent.

positives.english: A proposal to repair 18 Dhaulana roads has been sent to the state government
positives.hindi: *धौलाना की 18 सड़कों की मरम्मत का प्रस्ताव सरकार को भेजा गया है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (22 Sep 2026) reports PWD forwarded MLA Dharmesh Tomar's proposal for special repair of 18 Dhaulana-area roads, about Rs 6 crore; work starts only after state approval. Proposal only, not delivered. Routes named include Dasna-Dhaulana-Gulaothi road, inside AC extent.

positives.english: After rain, a municipal team was sent to waterlogged areas and drainage work is under way
positives.hindi: बारिश के बाद पालिका की टीम जलभराव वाले इलाकों में भेजी गई
positives.basis: Executive Officer Indrapal Singh is quoted as saying the municipal team was sent immediately to waterlogged areas and drainage work is underway where water removal was a problem. This is the official's claim as reported, not verified on the ground.

positives.english: A planned extension of the Hapur Chungi flyover to 1200 metres
positives.hindi: *हापुड़ चुंगी पर फ्लाईओवर 1200 मीटर तक बढ़ाने की योजना है
positives.basis: Inference: Daily Jagran (28 Aug 2025, archived article) says the flyover at Hapur Chungi will be extended to 1200 m from 800 m, funded by PWD, pending state approval. The article names Ghaziabad localities (Raj Nagar, Shastri Nagar, Sanjay Nagar, Kavi Nagar) and not Dhaulana; AC membership of Hapur Chungi unconfirmed; plan only.

positives.english: If the Pilkhuwa drains are fully built rainwater will not stay on the roads
positives.hindi: *पिलखुवा में नाले पूरे बने तो बारिश का पानी सड़क पर नहीं रुकेगा
positives.basis: Inference: no sourced completion date or outcome. Drawn from the Amar Ujala (28 Jul 2026) report that waterlogging was caused by drains not being cleaned on time and inadequate drainage arrangements.

negatives.english: Whenever it rains water fills Railway Road and Gandhi Road in Pilkhuwa
negatives.hindi: पिलखुवा में बारिश होते ही रेलवे रोड और गांधी रोड पर पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (28 Jul 2026): rain caused waterlogging across several Pilkhuwa neighbourhoods and main roads including Railway Road, Gandhi Road, Gandhi Bazaar, Jawahar Bazaar; drains not cleaned on time. Residents not quoted directly; commuters, drivers and students reported difficulty. Pilkhuwa MB is inside AC per Wikipedia extent.

negatives.english: The Partapur Road underpass is unfinished and thousands in Isad Nagar and Saddikpura are suffering
negatives.hindi: परतापुर रोड का अंडरपास अधूरा है इसाद नगर और सद्दीकपुरा के हजारों लोग परेशान हैं
negatives.basis: Pratahkal (12 Oct 2026): the unfinished underpass on Partapur Road in Pilkhuwa causes waterlogging and filth for thousands in Isad Nagar and Saddikpura; construction keeps being held up; AAP threatens protest at municipal premises. Localities are Pilkhuwa areas; Pilkhuwa MB is inside AC.

negatives.english: Farmers are angry that the previous season's full sugarcane dues have not been paid
negatives.hindi: गन्ने का पिछले सत्र का पूरा बकाया न मिलने से किसान नाराज हैं
negatives.basis: District-level: Amar Ujala (6 Oct 2026) reports a Sambhawali sugarcane committee meeting where farmer organisations demanded the full previous-season dues and cash or 14-day payment, and threatened a lockout of the sugar mill. The mill is not named and no dues figure is given; AC membership of the location not confirmed.

negatives.english: Many Dhaulana roads need special repair
negatives.hindi: धौलाना की कई सड़कों की विशेष मरम्मत की जरूरत है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (22 Sep 2026): PWD proposal for special repair of 18 roads in the Dhaulana area (about Rs 6 crore), including the Dasna-Dhaulana-Gulaothi road and a Modinagar-Hapur road stretch at Badnauli. The article gives no condition details beyond need for special repair. Dhaulana KC and Dasna are in AC extent per Wikipedia.

negatives.english: Villagers in Partapur are troubled by smoke from factories
negatives.hindi: परतापुर गांव में फैक्ट्रियों के धुएं से ग्रामीण परेशान हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (18 Apr 2026): residents complained of smoke; five people booked and three units (Moon Processors, Shri Rama Industries, Shri Balaji Processors) found burning plastic waste in boilers and emitting toxic gases; boilers sealed. Article places Partapur in Kotwali area, Pilkhuwa. AC membership of Partapur unconfirmed, so not counted as AC-specific.

notes: AC identity: Wikipedia list gives No. 58 as 'Dhaulana' (page 'Dholana Assembly constituency'), Hapur district, general seat, 2008 delimitation. Wikipedia extent: Hapur tehsil (Dhaulana KC incl. Shaulana, Dhikri, Karanpur, Kakrana, Narayanpur, Sapnawat and others; Pilkhuwa MB) and Ghaziabad tehsil (Ghaziabad KC excluding several PCs, Dasna NP). The Dholana article also says the seat is part of Ghaziabad district in one line; Hapur used as primary district per infobox and list. Hindi name spelled ढौलाना here; sources use धौलाना. POSITIVES ARE WEAK: no completed or delivered benefit in AC 58 was found in any opened source; ranks 1, 2, 4, 5 are planned or inference and flagged; rank 3 is an official claim. Dhaulana local coverage in Hindi outlets is thin; EHapur News (ehapurnews.com) runs Dhaulana items through Oct 2026 but its grievance-specific articles found were not about residents' complaints. Not cited: Newstrack Pilkhuwa drain article (403, could not open), The Statesman Hapur pollution article (403), SquareYards/99acres property feeds and undated resident reviews (aggregators). Hapur sugarcane dues and Simbhaoli mill are district-level, not confirmed inside AC. Partapur village membership unconfirmed. Electricity: a power-theft case at Dehra village in Dhaulana (EHapur News, 8-10 Oct 2026) concerns a raid, not residents' supply complaints, so not used. Field check suggested: ward-wise Pilkhuwa drain status, Partapur underpass timeline, Dhaulana power supply hours, Dasna civic issues (no 2026 Dasna civic news found).
